== Biography ==

The King receives a report from General Guph on the progress of a planned invasion. On hearing that the Growleywogs will join the effort, he reacts with shock, crying "No!" before catching himself and listening on "with interest." He is suspicious of the price the Growleywogs demand for their support, questioning Guph closely on what reward they ask, since he knows "how greedy the Growleywogs were" — his suspicion is confirmed when Guph reveals the Growleywogs mean to take some of the Oz people as slaves.

According to a legend recounted by the girl Ruler, a wicked King once ruled Oz long ago and made himself and his people miserable. Glinda the Good Sorceress placed a fountain to remedy this, and the King drank of its water, forgetting all his wickedness and becoming innocent and vacant-minded. Because his people still remembered and feared his former cruelty, he in turn made them all drink of the same Water of Oblivion, erasing their memories so that they became as simple and innocent as he was.
